bg.office.notes: Office of the bureau: Watsoni's desk (left), shelf, teapot, mirror, lamp on the cart (comfort lamp corner).

bg.office-desk.notes: Close-up of Watsoni's desk for the intern questionnaire (P0).

bg.map.notes: Pushistino map. Stage 1: only pirogovaya-street is active; other hotspots are for later stages.

bg.soap-workshop.notes: Tyopa's soap workshop; blueberry soap bubbling in the copper cauldron.

bg.shed-interior.notes: Inside Kartofan's shed: boxes on the workbench, seedlings, watering cans. Final conversation (C1-7).

bg.bakery-interior.notes: Finale: baking at the round table, honey-caramel oven glowing.

bg.bakery-oven.notes: T25 optional C1-8 moment: pie baking in the honey-caramel oven.

bg.library-door.notes: Quiet Burrow library door and the Shurshik mouse door with paper bunting.

bg.old-oak.notes: Old Oak: nest high in the crown, hollow low among the roots (two clearly different places).

bg.town-square.notes: Town square dressed for the Exhibition of Letters (case 2).

bg.office-evening.notes: The Office at dusk, warm lamps.

bg.honey-pond.notes: Honey Pond at dusk, lighthouse across the water (hub).

bg.pond-bank.notes: Pond bank where the mice play the recording shell.

bg.lighthouse-door.notes: Lighthouse door and Damka's boat with the patched oar and the chamomile.

bg.office-pantry.notes: Pantry under the Office stairs with twelve jars and a note.

bg.office-diary.notes: Watsoni's desk in the evening (diary timeline).
